chain.title: First Blade Of The Forest
chain.desc: A stick and a Twilight Forest ironwood ingot. Farmer's Delight cutting boards need a knife; this is the first one the twilight tech tree can supply.

chain.title: Portioning The Minotaur
chain.desc: Knife raw meef on a cutting board. Slices are the base of the pasta, wrap and wellington lines.

chain.title: Sauce From The Undergrowth
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: mushgloom, brown mushroom and onion. It is the binding ingredient in half this mod's savoury recipes.

chain.title: Minotaur With Mushrooms
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: raw meef slice, mushgloom sauce and raw pasta. The first proper meal a Twilight Forest player can cook.

chain.title: Baking With Torchberries
chain.desc: Milk, egg, sugar, wheat and torchberries. Torchberries glow, and so does the cake.

chain.title: Stew That Lights The Room
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: mushgloom, torchberries, glowstone dust and a bowl. Its own light source, and an ingredient in the Glow 113 line.

chain.title: Labyrinth Steel, Sharpened
chain.desc: A steeleaf ingot on a stick. Steeleaf comes out of the Labyrinth, so this knife marks that you got past the Minoshroom.

chain.title: Cut Off The Minoshroom
chain.desc: Dropped by the Minoshroom and by ordinary minotaurs through data/twilightdelight/loot_modifiers/. The largest single cut of meat in the mod.

chain.title: The Knight's Own Edge
chain.desc: A knightmetal ingot on a stick. Knightmetal comes from the Knight Stronghold, which puts this knife two bosses deep.

chain.title: Cooking On Mazestone
chain.desc: Campfire, mazestone brick, knightmetal and torchberries. A Farmer's Delight stove built entirely from Labyrinth spoil.

chain.title: Chipping A Naga Scale
chain.desc: Cut a naga scale with a Diamond Minotaur Axe. It is the only recipe in the ecosystem that uses the axe as a tool rather than a weapon.

chain.title: Carving The Hydra
chain.desc: Knife a hydra chop on a cutting board. The Hydra is the Twilight Forest's fourth boss and this is what it tastes like.

chain.title: Something That Regrew Three Times
chain.desc: Hydra meat, bread, onion, tomato and salad greens. A boss reduced to lunch.

chain.title: A Blade That Cooks Itself
chain.desc: Fiery ingot and a blaze rod, or an iron knife dipped in a fiery vial. Cutting with it sears what it cuts.

chain.title: The Pot That Needs No Fire
chain.desc: Fiery ingot, mazestone brick, an ironwood shovel and a water bucket. Twilight Forest's fiery metal turned into the ecosystem's best cooking pot.

chain.title: Hydra, Torchberries And Fire
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: hydra meat, fiery vial, naga scale, torchberries and tomato sauce. Three bosses in one dish.

chain.title: Baked From An Ice Bomb
chain.desc: Milk, egg, sugar, wheat and a Twilight Forest ice bomb. The Alpha Yeti's material, used for dessert.

chain.title: A Cake Cut From The Aurora Palace
chain.desc: An aurora block folded into cake batter. The Snow Queen's palace is now an ingredient supplier.

chain.title: Bottled Off Raw Ironwood
chain.desc: Glass bottle, ice and raw ironwood. A drink that only exists because ironwood is a Twilight Forest ore.

chain.title: Experiment 115, In A Bun
chain.desc: Twilight Forest's Experiment 115 with bread, onion, tomato and beetroot. The Ur-Ghast's laboratory food, repurposed.

chain.title: Cut From The Ur-Ghast's Trophy
chain.desc: Knifing an Ur-Ghast Trophy on a cutting board yields Experiment 110 and 113. The trophy is the Dark Tower's clear reward, and this mod turns it into a renewable ingredient.

chain.title: Reforged In Ghast Tears
chain.desc: Smithing Experiment 110 onto a Fiery Sword with a netherite template. The strongest weapon in the Twilight Forest ecosystem and the end of this chain.

chain.title: Everything That Grows Down There
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: fiddlehead, liveroot, root strand, fallen leaves, torchberry plant and vine. It needs six different twilight plants, so it is a botany completion quest disguised as soup.

chain.title: Cake From The Thorn Lands
chain.desc: The phytochemical family runs on Twilight Forest's thorn-and-liveroot materials and is the last dessert line to open.

notes: 90 ids resolve as assets/twilightdelight/models/item/<id>.json intersected with item./block. lang keys. The 163 block. lang keys include 72 dyed candle_cake variants which are correctly excluded by the model intersection. Ordering follows Twilight Forest's own boss ladder because the recipes do: ironwood_knife needs ironwood_ingot (pre-Naga), steeleaf_knife needs steeleaf_ingot (post-Naga/Lich), knightmetal_knife and maze_stove need knightmetal_ingot and mazestone_brick (Knight Stronghold), the hydra line needs hydra_chop, the fiery line needs fiery_ingot and fiery_vial, and teardrop_sword smiths onto a twilightforest:fiery_sword. Two mechanics worth noting, both read from data/twilightdelight/recipes/: naga_chip is cut from a naga_scale using twilightforest:diamond_minotaur_axe as the tool, and experiment_110 + experiment_113 are cut off a twilightforest:ur_ghast_trophy with a knife - a boss trophy turned into a renewable food ingredient. Boss trophies for the Naga, Minoshroom and Hydra are similarly knife-cuttable back into their materials. Mob drops verified in data/twilightdelight/loot_modifiers/: raw and cooked tomahawk_smeak from minotaur and minoshroom, twilightforest:experiment_115 from ghasts, carminite ghastguards and ghastlings. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: all seven ice creams and all four milkshakes, because every one of their recipes is forge:conditional on the Neapolitan mod (they need neapolitan:ice_cubes) and would be uncraftable without it. Parent items this addon assumes you already have: twilightforest:ironwood_ingot, twilightforest:steeleaf_ingot, twilightforest:knightmetal_ingot, twilightforest:fiery_ingot, twilightforest:fiery_vial, twilightforest:fiery_sword, twilightforest:mazestone_brick, twilightforest:torchberries, twilightforest:mushgloom, twilightforest:liveroot, twilightforest:raw_meef, twilightforest:hydra_chop, twilightforest:naga_scale, twilightforest:ur_ghast_trophy, twilightforest:aurora_block, twilightforest:ice_bomb, twilightforest:diamond_minotaur_axe, farmersdelight:cutting_board, farmersdelight:cooking_pot, farmersdelight:pie_crust.
